author: A clerk of the Wayrest court
pages:
#The First City

The Orcs built their city in the Wrothgarian Mountains, and their neighbors could not bear it. Bretons and Redguards together besieged it for thirty years and pulled it down stone by stone.

The Orcs went back to their strongholds and waited.

#And Again

They rebuilt it. It was taken again. They rebuilt it again. Every Breton historian writes that this time Orsinium is gone for good. Every Orc reads it, laughs, and goes back to the forge.

The present city stands. I have stopped writing that it will fall.
